title: Introducing Base - Coinbase
excerpts:
Introducing Base
By Will Robinson
Feb 23, 2023
Coinbase announced Base, an Ethereum Layer 2 network incubated inside Coinbase, on February 23, 2023. Base opened its mainnet to the public on August 9, 2023, after a developer-only period that began in July. Share this article

title: Coinbase launches blockchain Base to help developers build dApps on-chain | TechCrunch
excerpts:
Coinbase launches blockchain Base to help developers build dApps on-chain
Jacquelyn Melinek @jacqmelinek / 9:00 AM EST February 23, 2023
Coinbase announced on Feb. 23, 2023 that it is launching Base, a layer-2 blockchain built on Optimism's OP Stack. The company said the Base mainnet would open to everyone on Aug 9, 2023.
